data: Truly amazing game, wonderful story and 10/10 would recommend
Animation, Storyline, Cast and Soundtrack are 10/10, 10/10 Game
Gameplay is very good, story is worth it
Awesome game, great story, amazing art style, love it
My only complaint is with replayability
Predictable awful childish humour, completely uninteresting characters and very boring quick time events
The hacking minigame is just plain boring
it gets worse and worse as the story unfolds
how am I supposed to care about it at all when the characters on screen clearly don't
Sadly, there was no option to disable quips, which is what the majority of the dialogue was during the 20 minutes I sat through
Between this complete let-down and the annoying hacking mini game I've no desire to replay this
So yea, if you want to pay $30 for meh 8 episode anime with a Pac Man hacking contingent, go ahead
The gameplay there is, is split between dispatching and hacking, with no direct controllable engagement in the action
Gameplay loop is cheap and boring
If am asked if I want to turn mechanical gameplay elements off, then those gameplay elements shouldn't be in the game
Can't recommend this game enough. If you're unsure, go watch someone play the first episode and come back to buy and play the rest of the game if you're hooked by then. You won't regret, trust me.
What a great successor to the hole left in this genre. So excited to see what this studio does next.

If you're into this type of game, you will absolutely 100% love this game. The voice acting, writing, and animation are top tier. I've barely scratched the surface, so I'm looking forward to what's to come.

Outstanding! Over the last year I really got into Telltale-style games and this one was really fantastic. The animation, voice acting, soundtrack and characters are all so good; the production value is off the charts. And I really enjoyed the story, even though I am someone who doesn't usually like superhero stuff (other than the show The Boys).

I feel like it maybe lacked the impact of hard decisions that similar games like TWD and The Wolf Among Us had, but in a way that was kind of refreshing. Unlike those games it has less focus on QTEs and some surprisingly fun minigames. Solid 9/10 for me, really hoping for a second season.

Never really played a strictly narrivtive game like this before but it absolutely blew me away. Loved every single second of it.
Worth the buy not matter who you are.
I hate how the game keep pushing me to care for the bitchy gen z angry self inserted character and feel sorry for her, when the logical thing to do is to dump her quickly

Edit for episode 3 and 4: This review is still valid, it's the exact same thing so far, you can just watch the 2 different branches on youtube and have the same experience, replaying 50% of the game is worthless.

EPISODE 1 and 2:

Animation: 10/10
Replayability: 0/10

The game tells you that your choices matter, but honestly, nothing really changes. Every decision you make leads to the same result with tiny, lazy differences. It tries to trick you into thinking you’re shaping the story, but it’s so linear that it becomes obvious pretty fast.

It feels like one of those games where maybe a couple of choices at the very end will actually mean something, let's see if that changes in the next episodes. Until now, Even the big dramatic decisions are fake. If the story needs a character to ignore you, they will. If someone isn’t meant to die, it doesn’t matter what you do, they’ll survive. It’s just disappointing.

The animation is absolutely gorgeous, no doubt about it. But I didn’t buy a game just to watch cutscenes and pick slightly different dialogue options or tiny cosmetic changes. It looks amazing, but as a game, it’s falling flat so far

Finished the game and instantly bought digital deluxe upgraid to support devs.

Waiting for the next part

This is not really a game, but a "visual novel" with mostly meaningless interactions and "choices" and a mediocre minigame ("hacking") that made Paradroid in the 80s look sophisiticated.

At least that was the impression I got working through the prologue, where I invested 45 minutes (and felt longer) of cutscenes (is it still a cutscene if it's the majority of the content?) which were full of lots of meaningful looks and not really a lot going on. You can't even skip through the filler.

I had about 3 minutes of the aforementioned "game", which just felt like another barrier until something actually happens. I realise there's supposed to be more to this, like managing your team (which I thought the game would be about) but considering the amount of non-gaming content in the prologue I didn't want to risk wading through more exposition, for what was looking more and more to be minimal actual game content.

I'm sure this a great buy for those who like this sort of thing - the positive reviews suggest it has something going for it - but this is absolutely not the sort of thing for me and from what I saw is barely a "game".
Just finished and would recommend to anyone who enjoys a good story. This is the rare game I would play through again from the beginning.

The first 7 episodes were easily a 9/10, but the ending completely fell apart. Overall, the production quality and polish are excellent, but the 'dispatch' gameplay was so boring, it felt like actually being at work.

Do you like Telltale games and/or enjoyed season one of Invincible? Well, then this game is for you. Yes, decisions mostly doesn't matter, but man, this game delivers on story, characters, art style... sex appeal ;)
Only one complaint: it's too short. Hopefully team is working on season two of this star-packed masterpiece.

A wonderful story driven experience with many endings.
If you like 'Tell Tale' games, you will likely enjoy this title as well.
Not only do I enjoy the gameplay, but the cutscenes look great!
The character design is good. But more than anything the voice actors did a phenomenal job, in my opinion.

I would rate this game 7.5/10 overall
Excellent story, good gameplay loop, great characters, outstanding music, superb animation, running out adjectives to describe this game. Just go play it.
Great game. Normally not a fan of the Telltale format but the story is great and there's just enough gameplay to make it not feel like an interactive TV show.
Incredible story, great characters, a balanced mixture of seriousness and humor. Loved the game <3

Great Story, altho has some slight issues 

The Story is fairly enjoyabel, the cast of characters is really nice. Defo has some Invincible vibes in the sense that it merges Super Hero / Comic Book aspects with some more slice of life vibing themes.

Unlike most "tell-tale" games it actually has some gameplay to boot and those gameplay sements are genuienly really fun. The game would do well with an endless mode or a dungeon crawler inspired spin-off just for the minigame. I hope the devs will explore this aspect, with this or future games.

Only slight grime is that romance feels a bit forced, especially considering it happens in a work place environment, that some plot points seem a bit inconsistent (like Invisigirl not being abel to steal Popcorn despite making anything she has on her person invisible.

The biggest negative is that the decisions barely matter if at all. 

Everything else is pretty good, the writing and the story as well as the cast shine especially.
Basically playing a novel. The length of the game sucks, only get to do like 1 dispatch in episode 2? whats the total length of the game when full? 6 hours? If so the price is to high.

My personal GOTY.

Thank you, AdHoc Studio. It was truly an unforgettable experience. Looking forward to seeing your next project and/or season 2.

8/10

Great game overall. Loved the story, the choices for dialogue led to some good varieties and funny moments. Dispatching was fun, too; I loved being able to change up how certain heroes were built and play with the different synergies. Favorites were Flambae, Golem, and Prism/Malelova. 
During fight scenes, it feels like the quick-time events have little to no impact on the actual fight; I barely noticed any differences when I did them all vs missing all. I also wish there was something to keep me wanting to play the game, like an endless mode for dispatching; I know it doesn't fully fit with the genre, but I would personally really enjoy it. Minor gripe, but sometimes the speech bubbles don't pop up during the dispatching parts.

I’ve been waiting to play "Dispatch" since the trailer dropped & the moment I hit the main menu, I KNEW this game was GOLD. The episodic release format was a genius move & every episode had me fully locked in! The cinematic art style? Stunning. The story? Gripping. The characters? Incredible. I loved how your choices genuinely impact the ending. It made every decision feel important. I enjoyed every single minute of this experience. Easily one of my favorite games I’ve ever played. Absolutely 100% recommend.

Dispatch

The game has a structure similar to a TV series, with episodic storytelling, comedic moments, drama, and cliffhangers that make you want to see what happens in the next episode. Surprisingly, this format worked much better for me than I expected.But what really made me get invested in the game was its soundtrack and the journey along the way. While the different endings may not have as much impact on the overall story as I expected, the dialogue and relationships between the characters made me feel genuinely connected to both the main and supporting cast.Sometimes, I was genuinely surprised by how well the soundtrack and the story worked together, creating an experience that felt surprisingly cohesive and emotionally engaging.

Easiest way to describe it is that the game just *feels* really good to play. Every time I end a session it feels like coming out of an episode of an insanely well written show episode. One of the very few games of this style where the dialogue options come out exactly how I imagine them in my head, the lines really match the characters and I've never made a choice and felt like it wasn't the impression I had in my mind. Extremely cinematic and the best edition of this kind of game I've touched.
This game is so fun! Love the story, artwork, characters, and everything about it. This would be a great TV series in my opinion. Picked it up on sale, so definitely worth the money.

When there's a Telltale styled game, there's Adam. I didn't know about the game until I saw the first 10 minutes of Jack's video and thought to myself "I need to play this for myself."

I was invested from start to finish. I was feeling the Invincible vibe a lot but AdHoc studio managed to bring something unique and different, the Dispatching system. I didn't actually consider the fact that this might be the way how superheroes would work had they existed in real life, instead of just flying around aimlessly they would be directed towards specific locations provided by the dispatcher. It made me want to commit arson a few times because of how close I was to succeeding but failing at the last second but that's what you have to work with.

The voice acting is phenomenal. Every single voice actor outdid themselves, their characters seemed like real people. The character arcs were very well done and the consistent change could be observed continuously during the game. Even though the game revolved around just a few places, my overall enjoyment didn't suffer at all.

Apparently there are talks of a possible season 2 which I'm hyped for. Personally, I'd say we got a closed ending but I'm intrigued where the writers take the story next should they really start working on a sequel.
10/10.
Great characters, story, impactful choices, art style, and fun gameplay. An amazing mix of show / game!

Everyone already knows this game is fantastic. The price tag is a little steep for 8 hours but the quality of those hours is top notch. The writing and characters really take this one home. Definitely recommend.

This game is a breath of fresh air. It's like binge watching a season of The Boys or Jack Reacher... you just can't stop at 1 episode and you are craving to start the next one, then the next one.
BUT, I don't see myself redoing the game with different options, or trying to get better scores, or better dispatching sessions.
So, I recommend this game, but know that the game is very short and can be finished within a day.

Dispatch is one of those games that has a good story, good characters, good music, it makes it feel like you're actually part of the game. I was a bit skeptical since I wasn't a huge fan of choice games, but the replay value is worth trying to get all of the achievements, even if some moments do feel repetitive. 10/10 game, please make a season 2

Dispatch is a fantastic adventure with sharp writing, memorable characters and a story that keeps you invested from start to finish. It's the kind of experience that reminds you, how powerful good storytelling can be.

That said, calling it a game might be a bit generous. It's more of an interactive story than a gameplay-heavy experience. If you're okay with that, you're in for a great ride.

PLAY THIS GAME, IT IS WORTH WHATEVER I SPENT I CANT REMEMBER. This game is such an interesting idea, I love choice games where the player decides how the story ends.( it reminds me of almost like an invincible or the boys universe but with its own twist, and not to mention as a game) This is a game where you sit down try something new, it will make you laugh and actually interested in the story.

Well written and animated, a treat - the primary lure is the story but the core gameplay is fun as well. 
I am still busy with this game, but I am enjoying it immensely. 

I don't often get to enjoy a game that is more about the story than the gameplay itself, but here the gameplay is secondary to the storyline - and that's ok. Its very well done and I'm quite pleased with the result.

Graphics are well done and the animation is superb. Writing is excellent and the storyline is well put together.

This is easily one of the best games I've played in the last five years. It made me feel like I was 14 years old again, playing a video game for the first time. Every aspect of this game was phenomenal. It had a captivating storyline, engaging gameplay, complex characters brought to life by incredible voice actors, a perfect soundtrack, and a wicked sense of humor. I want to write a love letter to everyone who worked on this game. Thank you! <3

My only complaint? I need more game. I am begging on my hands and knees for a season two.

After playing through the entire story and getting the good ending, I can say this game is amazing. It reminds me a lot of Invincible and has a very compelling story. I am very glad I bought this game and I hope there is a season 2 sooner rather than later. I really hope this series is good enough to continue for the long run like Walking Dead.

Got this as a gift from my fiancé. Restarting episodes can be a pain in the ass, but I still really enjoyed playing it. My fiancé watched the whole time and even said it felt like watching a movie, especially with how the story and choices play out.

tldr.text: Overwhelmingly Positive (97%): players praise the story and characters, and the music and sound.
The main complaint is also the story and characters, with some finding the humour childish and the quick time events boring.

details.text: Recent reviews complain about gameplay more than before, with one calling the loop "cheap and boring".
Players who reviewed after under 2 hours are less positive, at 87%, than those with 2 to 10 hours, at 98%.
